facts.text: mrnav-v1 is registered with entry point gym_env.envs:mrnav
The environment class is mrnav, a gym.Env subclass with __init__, step_ir, render, reset, reset_one and show
mrnav wraps ir_gym and copies its observation_space and action_space
The declared observation space is Box(-inf, inf, shape=(5,), dtype=float32)
The declared action space is Box(low=[-1, -1], high=[1, 1], dtype=float32)
step_ir(action, vel_type='omni', stop=True) returns obs_list, reward_list, done_list and info_list
A robot observation concatenates current velocity, desired velocity, heading and collision radius with the RVO neighbour features, rounded to two decimals
A collision sets done true and the robot's arrival flag is returned as info
The movement reward is the collision parameter p7 on a collision plus the arrival parameter p8 on the first arrival
The per-robot reward is the RVO reward plus the movement reward
reset(mode=0, **kwargs) forwards to ir_gym.env_reset and returns the list of robot observations
env_reset calls robots_reset and then rebuilds the observations; the method does not reset obstacle state
The reset path takes a mode and forwards it to robots_reset; it supplies no seed value
The world configuration sets the simulation step_time to 0.1 s
The training loop builds the absolute velocity command as acceler * policy action + current velocity before calling step_ir
The simulator is the external intelligent-robot-simulator (ir-sim) v2.5
The class defines no get_state/set_state and the clone exposes no snapshot or restore path

determinism.notes: the clone's reset takes a mode and supplies no seed (ir_gym.py:175); robot initialisation and the dynamics live in the external ir-sim package (README.md:21), which was not run, so this package makes no replay claim

gaps: no dynamics are modelled by this package's fake: it is a pure Python kinematic stand-in for the external ir-sim engine, which was not run and was not compared with the fake
the declared observation_space is Box(shape=(5,)) (ir_gym.py:23) but observation_reward builds 6 + 8 = 14 values (ir_gym.py:102-109, :30); the fake returns 14 values for each robot
the reset path resets the robots only (ir_gym.py:173-179); obstacle state and any dynamic obstacles are not reset by env_reset, so reset is partial
no seed control: the clone's reset path takes a mode and no seed (ir_gym.py:175), so determinism is none and cap.world.reset.v1 reports seed 0 for the required class field
no wall-clock pacing: realtime_factor is 0 and ticks advance simulated time only by timestep_ms
snapshot and restore are not offered: the class has no get_state/set_state
the fake returns a smaller world than the upstream default (two robots, no obstacles) and its reward values are test data, not the upstream reward parameters

safe_state.description: the simulation stops advancing: cap.world.step.v1 and cap.world.reset.v1 are refused after an e-stop until mhs.safety.reset clears the latch; the world state stays readable
